title: Week x ranked topic x AI subtopic: how many of the topic's ring-1 articles carry the subtopic
description: BigQuery radar.topic_subtopic_weekly from radar.article_entities joined with radar.article_topic (ring 1 only) -> lake/gold/topic_subtopic_weekly.parquet. WS4 reads it for a topic's primary subtopic (the window chip's pooled lag, the fit rules). Multi-label: a topic's rows in one week can sum to more than its articles; articles with no subtopic count under subtopic null.

topic_id.description: 'org:<name>' or 'thm:<GKG theme>', the ids of topic_daily; persons never appear

week.description: Monday of the ISO week, the same week key as edges_weekly

subtopic.description: a subtopic id of contracts/taxonomy.yaml, or null for the topic's ring-1 articles with no subtopic

n_articles.description: distinct ring-1 articles of the week mentioning the topic and carrying the subtopic

n_topic_articles.description: distinct ring-1 articles of the week mentioning the topic (the denominator)
